6dd75c05e2.q: What is the Faraday reactor and how does it disinfect water differently than conventional electrocoagulation methods?
6dd75c05e2.a: The Faraday reactor uses alternating current at less than 12 volts of power, compared to conventional direct current electrocoagulation which uses 50 to 120 volts. It works by using electroporation to cut through cell walls of viruses and bacteria at a molecular level, combined with an advanced reduction process to break chemical chains like PFAS, followed by a dissolved air flotation device to separate solids without requiring membranes, filters, or chemical solutions.

0618f91652.q: How many cyber-attacks by Iran targeted water treatment facilities and what vulnerability did they exploit?
0618f91652.a: Multiple cities and facilities were cyber-attacked by Iran a few weeks before this episode was recorded. The attacks exploited vulnerabilities in old PLC systems and SCADA systems. In one instance, an operator discovered the breach only when he saw his mouse moving on its own, as the attacker had gained remote access through these systems.

b395ad751a.q: What are the main vertical markets for Water.com's water treatment technology?

f2eb1141ec.q: According to the World Health Organization, what is the current global water crisis status?
f2eb1141ec.a: The World Health Organization came out earlier in the year stating that the world has officially gone into water bankruptcy, meaning the balance of plus and minus assets versus liabilities no longer maps. The world is taking out more water than is being replenished.
